title: In This Town Your Face FADES If Nobody Looks
description:
In this town, if nobody looks at you, your face fades back to bare wood. Lonely people sit for the Wednesday portrait class, and the painters fill them back in.

Mum always said I never finish a face, and we haven't spoken since spring. So I joined the class to learn. On the stool sat someone faded all the way, and nobody else looked up.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: If you faded all the way, who would still be able to see you?
